newsitem.title: USA: Superior Telecom Inc Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Superior Telecom Inc Q3 net rises.

text.p: (Dollars in Thousands, Except Per Share Data)
Income per share of common stock

NOTE - (A) The unaudited pro forma operating data for periods prior to October 2, 1996 gives effect to the following transactions as if such transactions occurred on May 1, 1995: The completion of the reorganization of Superior Telecom, including the contribution by Alpine Group Inc of all the common stock of Superior Telecommunications Inc and DNE Systems Inc to Telecom; the completion of Telecom's debt refinancing and the repayment of all inter-company indebtedness to Alpine; the sale of 6,900,000 shares, which includes the exercise of the underwriter's over allotment option, of Telecom's common stock at $16.00 per share resulting in net proceeds of $101.7 million.
Also, the acquisition of the U.S. and Canadian copper telecommunications wire and cable business of Alcatel NA which occurred on May 11, 1995.

(B) Operating income, included in the comparative pro forma data, has been adjusted for periods prior to October 2, 1996 to reflect additional estimated general and administrative expense of $500,000 per quarter associated with Telecom's status as an independent public company.
